analysis: The trial crashed before producing a validation score. The supplied traceback only shows that train.py exited with status 1; it does not include the underlying exception, so the cause cannot be determined. The host recorded 1.9173 allocated GPU-seconds. No HR@10 or NDCG results are available, and the conditional-neighborhood hypothesis remains untested.
code_summary: Per-category sparse item-to-item ridge regression using binary training histories. Each target selects up to 128 neighbors by cosine co-occurrence similarity, excludes itself, and learns signed coefficients through a local covariance eigendecomposition shared across ridge strengths 10, 100, and 1000. Validation selects each category’s weights by HR@10, with NDCG as a tie-breaker, using up to 200 users and 99 unique negatives with seed 42. Inference sums learned coefficients over unique history items. The script preserves all four dataset routes and writes sparse weights plus a matching working/predict.py beneath the trial directory.
